text: The Greater Mekong Subregion Flood and Drought Risk Management and Mitigation Project (Cambodia) – Technical Assistance is part of a larger initiative by the Asian Development Bank to enhance climate and disaster resilience in the Lower Mekong Basin. The project focuses on preparing national roadmaps, prioritizing interventions, and conducting feasibility studies to support flood and drought risk management in Cambodia. It includes structural measures like irrigation and flood control infrastructure, and non-structural measures such as forecasting and community risk management.
